summary: Apply SHELL, Reason’s model and incident analysis to railway safety-critical work. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: Railway human factors and error management examines how people, tasks and systems interact in safety-critical work. For railway safety, operations and maintenance professionals, it provides practical ways to map tasks with the SHELL Model, trace error pathways using Reason’s Swiss Cheese Model, and review fatigue, communication and incident evidence. Participants also classify contributing factors with adapted HFACS and develop Bowtie-based controls and prioritized safety actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for railway professionals who investigate incidents, manage safety-critical work or need to improve operational controls across shifts and teams.
modules: Railway Human Factors in Safety-Critical Work
SHELL Model for Railway Task Analysis
